fields.name: production_process
fields.rationale: The production process is crucial for understanding the properties and applications of steel products. It includes thermomechanically-rolled, heat-treated, normalized, and high-strength processes.
evidence: thermomechanically-rolled, heat-treated, normalized and high-strength heavy plates

fields.name: application_areas
fields.rationale: The application areas help categorize the product based on its end-use, which is important for selecting the right type of steel for specific engineering needs.
evidence: The areas of application for heavy plate include: Steel and bridge construction, Tank and plant construction, Wind industry, Boiler and pressure vessel engineering, Yellow Goods, Mechanical engineering, Shipbuilding, Pipelines

fields.name: rolling_technology
fields.rationale: The rolling technology, such as 'quarto rolling stands', affects the mechanical properties and dimensions of the steel product.
evidence: The rolling stands are so-called quarto rolling stands, consisting of four rolls: two work rolls and two back-up rolls.
